summary_1line: Jayadratha, empowered by Shiva’s boon, single‑handedly holds back the Pandavas and their allies, displaying swift archery and repeatedly repelling their attempts to break Drona’s formation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Jayadratha stands on his jeweled chariot with a silver boar banner and white umbrella, loosing arrows in all directions as the Pandava heroes converge on him.
Bhima leaps from his wrecked chariot onto Satyaki’s car like a lion climbing a mountain after Jayadratha’s arrows cut down his steeds.
Jayadratha rapidly seizes a fresh bow the instant Yudhishthira cuts his first one, immediately showering arrows back at the Pandava leaders.
